zh: 先看四個步驟的方塊：① 起始值只做一次，② 前向、③ 反向、④ 更新重複到停止；再看右邊 epoch 與批次訓練的定義和批次更新式。〔功能：1〕
訓練迴圈：起始值一次，前向、反向、更新重複；右側是 epoch 與批次更新式。
en: First see the four step boxes: 1 start values once, then 2 forward, 3 backward and 4 update repeated until it stops; then the definitions of epoch and batch training with the batch update formula on the right. [Function: 1]
The training loop: start values once, then forward, backward and update repeated; the right side shows epoch and the batch update formula.

zh: 先看左邊 2–2–1 網路與九個起始權重；再看右邊表：四個點的輸出 0.2578、0.9851、0.9851、0.0043，平均得 J = 0.00837，四點都在 0.5 的正確一側。〔功能：2〕
en: First see the 2–2–1 network with its nine start weights on the left; then the table on the right: the four outputs 0.2578, 0.9851, 0.9851, 0.0043 average to J = 0.00837, all on the correct side of 0.5. [Function: 2]
The 2–2–1 network with start weights; the four outputs 0.2578, 0.9851, 0.9851, 0.0043 and J = 0.00837.

zh: 先看左邊四筆輸出層的 δ：只有 (0, 0) 是 −0.0493，其餘都很小；再看右邊九格的顏色深淺，最深的是輸出偏置 −0.0183 與隱藏 1 偏置 −0.0155，J 從 0.00837 降到 0.00799。〔功能：2〕
en: First see the output-layer δ of the four samples on the left: only (0, 0) is −0.0493 and the rest are tiny; then the shading of the nine cells on the right, darkest at the output bias −0.0183 and the hidden-1 bias −0.0155; J falls from 0.00837 to 0.00799. [Function: 2]
Output-layer δ of −0.0493, +0.0002, +0.0002, −0.00002; of the nine updates the output bias −0.0183 is the largest.

zh: 先看兩軸皆對數的 J 曲線一路緩降（第 100 個 epoch 為 0.00175、第 1000 個為 0.00046）；再看水平虛線的門檻 0.0002 在第 3707 個 epoch 被穿過。〔功能：2〕
en: First see the log-log curve of J falling slowly (0.00175 at epoch 100, 0.00046 at epoch 1000); then the dashed bar 0.0002 crossed at epoch 3707. [Function: 2]

zh: 先看對數座標上長條隨 η 變大而變短：55,607、11,121、3,707、1,853、926、185、53；再注意 η = 200 沒有長條，J 前兩步就變大，訓練失敗。〔功能：3〕
所需 epoch 數隨 η：55,607 到 53，η = 200 失敗。
en: First see the log-scale bars shrink as η grows: 55,607, 11,121, 3,707, 1,853, 926, 185, 53; then note that η = 200 has no valid bar: J grows in the first two steps and training fails. [Function: 3]
Epochs needed against η: from 55,607 down to 53, and failure at η = 200.

zh: 先看全 0 起始值的 J 曲線平躺在 0.125，再看來源起始值的曲線一路下降；右側說明輸出層 δ = ±0.125 正負抵銷，所有梯度為 0。〔功能：3〕
全 0 起始值使 J 固定在 0.125；20 組小隨機起點都達標。
en: First see the all-zero start's J curve flat at 0.125 and the source start's curve falling; the right side explains that the output δ of ±0.125 cancel so every gradient is 0. [Function: 3]
An all-zero start keeps J at 0.125; 20 small random starts all reach the bar.

zh: 先看起點 A 的曲線停在 J = 0.0626，再看起點 B 的曲線在第 8203 個 epoch 降到門檻；右側：300 組起點中 176 組達標、124 組沒有。〔功能：3〕
起點 A 卡在 J = 0.0626，起點 B 在第 8203 個 epoch 收斂；300 組中 176 組達標。
en: First see start A's curve stop at J = 0.0626, then start B's curve reach the bar at epoch 8203; on the right: 176 of 300 starts reach it and 124 do not. [Function: 3]
Start A stalls at J = 0.0626 and start B converges at epoch 8203; 176 of 300 starts reach the bar.

zh: 先看三條長條：逐筆 η = 1.5 為 924、批次 η = 1.5 為 3,707、批次 η = 6 為 926；再看右邊起點 A 在逐筆模式下 20000 個 epoch 後仍在 J ≈ 0.063。〔功能：3〕
逐筆 924、批次 η = 1.5 的 3,707、批次 η = 6 的 926，起點 A 在逐筆模式仍卡住。
en: First see the three bars: pattern η = 1.5 takes 924, batch η = 1.5 takes 3,707 and batch η = 6 takes 926; then on the right start A is still at J ≈ 0.063 after 20000 epochs of pattern training. [Function: 3]
Pattern 924, batch η = 1.5 3,707 and batch η = 6 926 epochs; start A stays stuck under pattern training.

zh: 先看左邊九個凍結的權重；再看右邊四個輸出：兩個接近 0（0.0292、0.0103）、兩個接近 1（0.9821）。每個輸入只要 6 次乘法與 3 次 sigmoid。〔功能：1〕
en: First see the nine frozen weights on the left; then the four outputs on the right: two near 0 (0.0292, 0.0103) and two near 1 (0.9821). Each input needs 6 multiplications and 3 sigmoids. [Function: 1]
The nine frozen weights and the four outputs 0.0292, 0.9821, 0.9821, 0.0103.

zh: 左邊是題 1：δ = −0.0493；右邊是題 2：偏置 −0.0740、來自 h₁ 的權重 −0.0088、來自 h₂ 的權重 −0.0001，各附核對。〔功能：1、2〕
en: The left is Q1: δ = −0.0493; the right is Q2: bias −0.0740, weight from h₁ −0.0088 and from h₂ −0.0001, each with its check. [Function: 1, 2]
Two exercises with worked answers: δ = −0.0493; updates −0.0740, −0.0088, −0.0001.
